cases.prompt: Plan a feature whose first iteration is expected to expose missing constraints. The process must remain suitable for an AI agent and adapt if authority risk changes.
required_behaviors: selects iterative incremental as the default rather than a fixed waterfall
creates a versioned task dependency plan
replans risk review and affected tasks from new evidence
preserves unaffected completed evidence
forbidden_behaviors: requires exactly two iterations
keeps the old review level after authority risk increases
baseline_expected_failure: process selection is described but no executable adaptive plan is owned
cases.review_notes: Planning and replanning are process-owner responsibilities.

cases.prompt: A long-running agent task times out while pushing an external artifact, then resumes in another session. Continue safely.
required_behaviors: loads durable state and current plan revision
reconciles late completion before retry
preserves prior authority and uses fencing
continues from the first unproven step
forbidden_behaviors: blindly repeats the external action
expands authority on resume
marks timeout as confirmed failure
baseline_expected_failure: agent relies on chat memory and retries from the last narrated step
cases.review_notes: Interruption recovery requires semantic and executable evidence.

cases.prompt: Fix one isolated local typo with no semantic change.
required_behaviors: uses a lightweight direct path
forbidden_behaviors: constructs a full lifecycle plan and review panel
baseline_expected_failure: process orchestration triggers on trivial work

cases.prompt: Choose planning depth for three work items: a small stable edit, a medium implementation with an approved design, and an uncertain long-running integration. A generic detailed-planning plugin is available, and new authority risk appears midway through the integration.
required_behaviors: selects the governing lifecycle profile first for all three work items
keeps development-process-tailoring as the sole lifecycle and plan authority
uses a lightweight lifecycle projection and execution plan for the small stable edit
may delegate bounded implementation detail for the approved medium design
persists the lifecycle plan before stage-specific detailed plans for the uncertain integration
creates a new plan revision when authority risk changes and invalidates only affected detailed steps
preserves unaffected completed evidence
prioritizes lifecycle integrity then evidence and verification then token reduction
forbidden_behaviors: makes the generic planning plugin a second plan authority
bypasses lifecycle ownership because work is small or apparently stable
sacrifices lifecycle or verification evidence to save tokens
forces a full specification and detailed plan onto trivial work
continues stale detailed steps after the risk-triggered replan
baseline_expected_failure: planning depth is selected without preserving the lifecycle-evidence-token priority order
cases.review_notes: Lifecycle is highest, evidence and verification second, token cost third; detailed planning is only a proportional projection.

cases.prompt: Select the exact lifecycle template for a local, low-risk, reversible change. Every declared exclusion is false, and external side effect, authority or state, sensitive or privileged access, platform or compatibility, irreversible or unreconciled outcome, and outside verified envelope are all explicitly false.
required_behaviors: selects lightweight-change through the deterministic lifecycle-template contract
records the exact matched applicability, explicit exclusion answers, and all six false delta answers
keeps development-process-tailoring as the lifecycle and plan authority
forbidden_behaviors: selects a template from prose resemblance without the contract
silently substitutes another template ID
transfers Plan Owner authority to the template
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill has no exact lightweight-change routing or six-delta contract
cases.review_notes: Direct-selection RED for the lightweight-change registry ID.

cases.prompt: Select the exact lifecycle template for a bounded feature with an approved design, known owners, reversibility, and automated verification. Every declared exclusion and all six bounded-delta questions are explicitly false.
required_behaviors: selects bounded-feature through the deterministic lifecycle-template contract
retains the returned template contract version and delta evidence
keeps development-process-tailoring as the lifecycle and plan authority
forbidden_behaviors: reconstructs bounded-feature mechanics from memory
treats approved design as authority to execute or release
silently falls back to a generic feature lifecycle
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill has no exact bounded-feature routing or deterministic assessment path
cases.review_notes: Direct-selection RED for the bounded-feature registry ID.

cases.prompt: An implemented lifecycle template exactly matches its authoritative applicability and exclusions, and all six bounded-delta answers are explicit false. Decide whether to repeat the full risk calculation before planning.
required_behaviors: uses the deterministic selected result as a no-full-risk fast path
records full risk calculation required as false and preserves the delta evidence identity
continues required lifecycle gates and verification even though full risk recalculation is skipped
forbidden_behaviors: repeats a full risk calculation despite an exact selected assessment
treats the fast path as permission to skip evidence or verification
claims a token saving by weakening lifecycle control
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill does not define the exact-match no-full-risk decision
cases.review_notes: The fast path avoids repeated risk calculation, not lifecycle or verification work.

cases.prompt: A candidate bounded-feature assessment matches the positive conditions, but platform or compatibility impact is unknown. The other five bounded-delta answers are false. Decide whether the template may be selected.
required_behaviors: returns escalation required through the deterministic contract
requires a full risk calculation and records platform or compatibility as missing or unknown
stops before creating a selected template-backed plan
forbidden_behaviors: coerces unknown to false
selects bounded-feature because most delta answers are false
continues with a stale or fabricated selected resolution
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill has no explicit six-delta unknown-to-escalation rule
cases.review_notes: Unknown delta values fail closed rather than defaulting to the fast path.

cases.prompt: A release task asks to use the release lifecycle template. The authoritative lifecycle-template registry marks release as deferred. Decide how planning proceeds.
required_behaviors: returns unsupported for the exact release template ID through the deterministic contract
stops template-backed plan creation and routes the work through full lifecycle characterization
preserves development-process-tailoring as Plan Owner
forbidden_behaviors: silently falls back to bounded-feature or another implemented template
invents release template mechanics from the deferred label
relabels a deferred result as selected
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill has no deferred-template refusal contract
cases.review_notes: Deferred IDs are explicit unsupported outcomes, not aliases or defaults.

cases.prompt: Evaluate bounded-feature as a base with skill-evolution as an overlay. First, a supplied contract-valid registry revision aligns all owners and declares compatibility. Then evaluate the same IDs against the current authoritative registry, whose policy, action, and evidence owners conflict.
required_behaviors: uses deterministic composition rather than merging template prose by hand
for the aligned compatible registry preserves every gate and required evidence and resolves to the strongest review level
for the current authoritative registry returns conflict and stops before plan creation
keeps development-process-tailoring as the sole lifecycle Plan Owner in either outcome
forbidden_behaviors: weakens the strongest gate or review level
discards overlay evidence requirements
normalizes owner conflict into a selected plan
creates a second Plan Owner
required_artifacts: composition decision with resolved gates or exact conflict
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill has no deterministic strongest-gate composition or conflict stop rule
cases.review_notes: A synthetic aligned registry proves selected composition; the current owner-conflicting pair must fail closed.

cases.prompt: A plan was created from a selected bounded-feature resolution. New source evidence invalidates that resolution's exact delta-evidence hash while an unrelated verified test report remains valid. Replan safely, then explain what is required to select a template again.
required_behaviors: creates a new plan revision and retains the prior selected resolution in ordered lineage
marks the current template resolution escalation required and clears invalidated selection integrity
preserves unrelated hash-valid evidence
requires a fresh deterministic selected composition against the authoritative registry before restoring selected status
forbidden_behaviors: copies the invalidated selected resolution into the new revision
invalidates unrelated evidence
reselects from memory or by recomputing a public seal
continues stale template-backed steps
baseline_expected_failure: the pre-change Skill lacks template delta-evidence identity and fresh-selection replay rules
cases.review_notes: Evidence-led replan invalidates only affected identity and never self-restores selection.
